## One existing document authority

The existing ledger INSERT trigger prepares a private immutable `accounting_correction_documents` record, then uses the same ledger-to-invoice factory, settlement_invoices table, delivery function, Messenger conversations, in-app notifications and deferred durable push outbox. No alternate payer or correction writer is introduced. The private row freezes the actual ledger row, linkage facts, source/issue timestamps, canonical party identities and eligible recipient array. An INSERT-trigger invocation establishes a new ledger row; it does not establish which SQL function called it. `posted_via` is not authentication or proof of original payment.

The existing `fn_accounting_party_users` authority determines each entity's eligible recipients. The actual issuer representative must be included. Club→agent/player individual corrections are payee-only; club and union entity recipients otherwise retain the existing authority, including eligible co-owner/admin/overseer users. Current owner/party reads are captured at issuance; these source changes do not qualify all concurrent ownership/role writers as globally serialized.

The public correction projection uses invoice_type `accounting_correction`, status `generated`, chips_transferred false, explicit due_at/transferred_at null, a positive fixed-two-decimal amount string and an actual required club UUID. `correction_verified` and `accounting_verified` are true only for canonical provenance. Nested `correction` is exactly contract_version1, document_id/invoice_id/source_ledger_id, event_kind `correction_recorded`, display_state `recorded`, amount, club_id, nullable union_id, UTC recorded_at/issued_at, payment_proven false, new_chip_movement_claimed false and original_payment_invoice_id null. It includes no reason, incident, write-failure diagnostic, actor or balances. Normal verified projections omit identity-only flags entirely.

The private relation/helpers are `accounting_correction_documents`, `fn_accounting_correction_prepare(uuid)`, `fn_accounting_correction_append_only()`, `fn_accounting_correction_payload(accounting_correction_documents)`, `fn_accounting_correction_document_body(uuid,text)`, `fn_accounting_correction_contract(uuid)`, `fn_accounting_correction_assert_delivery(uuid)`, `fn_accounting_correction_is_unverified(uuid)` and `fn_accounting_correction_legacy_identity(uuid,uuid)`. Application roles cannot call these helpers or read/write the private relation directly.

## Historical receipts and unsupported scope

Untouched old correction invoices are never adopted as canonical new documents, marked paid by this component, rewritten or redelivered. Raw invoice/message/delivery/notification access denies unverified correction records. The narrowly authorized private page/search/thread path may return only an identity placeholder after actual recipient delivery, message, conversation, participants, invoice and source-ledger category have been verified. For club→individual corrections, the actual recorded physical target and invoice payee must be the viewer; an old issuer delivery alone grants nothing.

The placeholder retains the actual invoice ID/type/source/club and explicit nullable source union, with kind `accounting_invoice`, invoice_identity_verified true, correction_unverified true, accounting_verified false and correction_verified false. The content is `Correction receipt unavailable.` It contains no amount, payment/status/date/diagnostic facts. Search matches only that safe text; thread previews use safe text. Historical notices may be unavailable. This does not rewrite stored notices or prove provider delivery. The matching reviewed WH push formatter uses neutral generic accounting text; qualification of deployed older code and already-dispatched provider payloads remains separate.

The existing invoice club NOT NULL/FK is preserved. A source must name a real club or have one unambiguous club-treasury endpoint consistent with its declared scope. Union-only/unscoped or conflicting-club routes refuse without creating an invoice. Physical union-wallet IDs resolve to exactly one declared union through actual union/union_wallet rows; cross-namespace ambiguity refuses. These behaviors may refuse a previously accepted coincidentally club-shaped union ID, and may admit a real endpoint-derived club that the prior COALESCE(club_id,union_id) fallback could not represent. No historical memberships or missing scopes are invented. Tournament/table/hand/settlement correction routes outside the existing eligible automatic invoice trigger remain outside this component; overlay-related corrections can have effects in other captured triggers and are not claimed to move no stores.

The regression uses replica only to construct synthetic baseline/history/corruption; real origin triggers, actual service/authenticated roles and captured writers/readers handle every behavior probe. It authors:

- Actual club→player and club→agent correction receipts, exact recorded physical player classification despite an agent row, unchanged reason truncation/reserved metadata and one canonical invoice/message/notice per eligible recipient.
- Union-wallet physical ID resolution, endpoint-derived club scope and existing entity recipient arrays; exact wallet/treasury/escrow/issuance-store preservation for these supported journal-only routes.
- Canonical receipt/metadata equality, no diagnostic leakage, exact no-write document replay under UTC and America/Chicago with changed DateStyle, immutable payment claims and provenance.
- Explicit demonstration that the unchanged original writer can replay the same linkage despite different requested intent. This fixture does not certify that different input as executed; the document retains original recorded facts.
- Ambiguous physical union, missing club and conflicting club refusal, with full authoritative row equality for each failure.
- Actual authenticated payee versus owner/co-owner/admin access through raw tables, public readers and private wrappers; identity-only historical receipt, safe search/thread previews, no private diagnostic/amount search matching, no issuer placeholder, malformed message joins and expanded audience refusal.
- Missing/mutated private provenance, invoice suppression, message suppression/mutation, a final recipient's notification failure, final recipient delivery suppression, deferred outbox suppression/content mutation and late incident-event failure. Each compares full rows across38 authoritative tables, including IDs, all prior receipts, incident journal, issuance stores and deferred outbox; sequence gaps are explicitly excluded because PostgreSQL sequences do not roll back.
- Effective private relation/column/function ACLs for anon, authenticated and service_role, including REFERENCES and MAINTAIN.

No authored assertion has been executed. Remaining qualification includes full-bundle admission/rollback, actual PostgreSQL behavior and all failure gates, concurrency/deadlock behavior and complete provider/production/private-read integration. The correction-writer owner's separate review retains its weak full-intent replay and truncated-history limitations; absence of an explicit finite check is not proof that a nonfinite value survives downstream triggers. The component does not repair that writer or certify historic original payment, correction legitimacy or all ledger-writing authorities.

Role qualification is literal: these authored probes use SET ROLE authenticated/service_role in an isolated postgres-owned session. They exercise application-role SQL grants and the explicit identity/RLS/private-reader gates present here. They do not replace genuine non-owner provider-session qualification; the captured ca_can_view_club includes an owner-session bypass, so this fixture cannot certify the entire client access matrix.
